answer: A practical defence is Delegated penetration tester certification with security testing attestation. It rests on a certification testing officers renew after assessed engagements, which gives every honest agent a plume that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the sable compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the willow is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
